contradicted: Three things in the dispatch's own framing turned out to be wrong or unavailable at this SHA, reported per DEV_PROCESS 3.2 (reporting a planner figure as wrong is a successful outcome). (1) `mergeBakedBaseFacts` does not exist anywhere in legacy-design-tools origin/main; `git grep -in 'mergeBaked\|BakedBaseFacts' origin/main` returns no hits. It was named as a Tier-1 bake symbol to read. (2) The dispatch's framing that the four pre-verified guards define the safe zone is correct as far as it goes, but LDT-07 shows one of them, isNullPlaceholderFeature, is conditionally vacuous: under a DBF header that upper-cases Prop_ID it returns true for EVERY feature, which widens the very decline exception it was narrowed to close. A guard verified against three counties' headers inherits those headers as an unstated precondition. (3) The dispatch says a loud throw is already safe. LDT-33 is a counterexample worth naming: TXGIO_MAX_FEATURE_CELLS throws loudly and, because it throws, halts an entire county on one right-of-way parcel. Loud is safer than silent, and it is not the same as harmless.
missionPremise: P-181 rests on the Factory model law premise that 254 counties must not each teach the same lesson serially (CANON-PREAMBLE, THE FACTORY IS THE ONLY WRITER PATH, OPS-19), combined with the ENFORCEMENT governing rule that an artifact which exists, is correct, and does nothing is this operation's characteristic defect. The work is therefore a read of WRITE PATHS, not a measurement of output: per ENFORCEMENT, 'every real defect in this operation to date was found by reading a write path; none were found by measuring output.' The register predicts breakage from what the code BELIEVES, before any county is baked, because measuring output applies the same predicates that admitted the defect.
completionPredicate: Done when a stranger holding only the artifact and a county's source files can, without reading legacy-design-tools, (a) name which ingest assumptions that county would violate, and (b) run a probe against the SOURCE that settles each one before a row is written. Concretely: the artifact declares its SHA and the exact files opened; every row cites file and line; every row states its failure mode and whether a guard exists; every row states whether a pre-bake source probe exists and, if so, names the request, the field and the comparison; a COULD NOT ESTABLISH section names what was not settled and why; and rows that are already safe are reported as safe so nobody re-fixes them. All six hold.
scopeBasis: Boundaries were set by the dispatch's file list plus what that list reaches by import, read at origin/main only. IN: the TxGIO/StratMap geometry and land-use ingest, the shared normalize/csv/zip/download helpers, the four vendor parsers (PACS, Orion, DCAD, TAD), the cad_property upsert merge, the declared-vintage resolver, the zoning stamp and its layer registry and fetcher, and the Tier-1 bake compute plus its parcel join. OUT, deliberately and named in the artifact rather than left unmentioned per DEV_PROCESS 3.3: the permits, boundary, address and NFHL subtrees; the Tier-2 bake; nodeFacetBakeTier1Conformant.ts beyond three grepped lines; publishedIdentifierBackfill, williamsonAgValuation, vintage-crosswalk and vintage-fallback. Also out: anything outside legacy-design-tools, which is why mergeBakedBaseFacts was reported absent here rather than hunted in cortex-api or hauska-engine. Depth was traded for breadth on the dispatch's own instruction (15 to 30 solid rows across a broad read, not 5 exhaustive ones); the register returned 38 short rows rather than 30, and the extra 8 are the fail-closed class, which costs a reader little and prevents re-fixing.

LESSON: A gate that fires only at exactly zero is this repo's recurring shape: landuse-cli `rowsParsed === 0`, ImprovementVocabularyMismatchError `matchedSegments === 0`, and the zoning index's empty-set path all pass a county that is 99 percent broken. The geometry path solved this properly with a paired absolute-plus-fraction ceiling (parse.ts:327-370); the pattern exists in the repo and is simply not applied on the other paths.

A fixed-width parser's only length check being a MINIMUM is presence-shaped, not meaning-shaped: it proves the record reaches the deepest offset read and proves nothing about whether the offsets are the right ones. The meaning-shaped version needs a second derivation, either the layout version from the publisher or a numeric-span type assertion at depth.
